note: D (Isometric block) and E (Abstract mark) stay as the iteration columns. Tom will mark the icon styles to drop.

launch.note: Tom chose C of spike 34 (2026-11-09): Strata. The dawn as seven flat bands, night to gold, squeezed again in the water; one white hairline climbs through them to a glowing dot; five reeds in ink; grain. Hover climbs the line and warms the bands. The emblem is line work: six band edges that tighten toward the horizon, four water lines, a hairline and dot, two reed pairs. It replaces A of spike 33 (Ascent, dawn).

vortex.note: Tom chose F of spike 30 (2026-11-09): one frame of the toy in its own grain. A ring of smoke particles crosses the grainy green cone; particles in the cone turn green. Pointer x flies the ring; the tube rolls. The emblem is F3, a halftone of the frame.

window.note: Tom picked direction A of spike window-3 (2026-11-09): the toy at dusk as it opens, violet sky down to an ember horizon, towns below, the slate wing and its red beacon, in the tilted pane with the moulded reveal, frost, scratches and grain. The pointer leans the view; the towns slide past; the wingtip strobe double-flashes. The emblem is the pane ring, the wing, the horizon and three stars.

ink.note: Current is direction F: a bloom traced from a frame of the toy, cut into four density bands in a square tile; the pointer looks into it and stirs the bands. The emblem is the tile and the bands as luminance steps.

oilslick.note: Current is direction B of the fresh round: a fingerprint pressed into a tile of oil film; the ridges cut through to the dark; the whorl core follows the pointer. The emblem is the tile with the ridges cut out.

foil.note: Current is direction A: a scrunched sheet of tilted facets on a hard shadow; the light turns and each facet flashes. The emblem is the lit facets in white.

trails.note: Current is direction A: five trails spiral round the pole in a lit porthole; the emblem is a heavy ring, four trails, the pole and a solid hill.

glass.note: Current is the shaded pane redo with an organic fracture (Fracture 2).

rain.note: Current is a dusk pane with winded streaks on arcs, moving on hover. A stays on the sheet.

tvtree.note: Current is the neat redraw: three crooks, three sets. D, the block tree, stays on the sheet for a future implementation.

putty.note: The new A, the tin. Installed in the menu.

windmap.note: Tom chose A2 of spike windmap-2 (2026-11-09): a gloss globe in the main-shelf style, with silk strands, one warm storm and the pole axis. No plate, no hard shadow. The pointer drags the storm; it winds up and the strands flow. The emblem is the same globe, slimmed.

fireworks.note: Tom chose A of spike fireworks-2 (2026-11-09): one peony bloom as a sphere of comet stars, tails fading in from the dark and burning white at the head, drooping under gravity. The pointer turns the sphere; hover fires it again in the next colours, with glitter.

motorway.note: Tom chose A of spike motorway-1 (2026-11-09): Brussels from overhead, the ring and its spokes from the toy's own map, in sodium on a night tile with grain. On hover the lamps die, then strike again in a ripple out from the centre: neon pink, salmon, sodium.

dijkstra.note: Tom chose A of spike dijkstra-2 (2026-11-09): a neat seven by seven street grid on a night tile, two merged blocks and a fast avenue. Light flows out along every street with a soft tip; the path draws on to the junction nearest the pointer and the rest recedes.

sonar.note: Current is direction A without the ear notch: a porthole on the live Listen waterfall; new rows hear the bearing under the pointer. The emblem is a heavy ring round a ship line, its harmonic and a whale glide. D (the 3D waterfall) stays for later.

archive: Cut directions move to icons/archive/. They stay out of development context unless Tom asks.
